# Changes made for Open Cereal Workshop

This is egui-winit 0.31.1 (MIT OR Apache-2.0, see LICENSE-MIT) with one addition: `src/lib.rs` gains the
`key_side` module and three lines that feed it, so the program can tell number pad keys from the top row
and the right Shift, Ctrl and Alt keys from the left ones. Nothing else is changed.
